professionalSummary.text: Experienced Controls Engineer with expertise in writing and maintaining PLC programs (IEC 61131-3) and HMI screens for packaging lines, including structured-text and ladder logic for case packers and labellers on ControlLogix controllers.
professionalSummary.witness: wrote structured-text and ladder logic for case packers and labellers on ControlLogix controllers

experienceHighlights.text: Managed version control for 140 controller programs, implementing a system with check-in comments and named reviewers for every change.
experienceHighlights.witness: Moved 140 controller programs from a shared drive into a version-control tool for automation projects, with a check-in comment and a named reviewer for every change.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported commissioning of line changes, including I/O checks and handover to operations, for a second labeller added to line 4.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the I/O checks and wrote the operator handover sheet when a second labeller was added to line 4, and stayed on site for the first two shifts after restart.

experienceHighlights.text: Collaborated with IT security on plant network zoning and conduit documentation, including cell zone division and conduit mapping between plant and office networks.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took part in workshops with the IT security team that divided the plant network into cell zones and documented the conduits between them and the site office network.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a change record for the line 4 labeller program, including program diff, reviewer comments, I/O checklist, and shift supervisor acceptance signature.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a change record for the line 4 labeller program, showing the program diff, the reviewer's comments, the I/O checklist completed during commissioning and the shift supervisor's acceptance signature.

skills.text: ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist certification in progress, with training courses IC32 and IC33 completed in June 2026 and exam booked for 18 November 2026.
skills.witness: ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist: training courses IC32 and IC33 completed in June 2026; certificate exam booked for 18 November 2026.
